gmp: Native GMP 6.3 DIV2=1, actual loader paths verified before hardware comparisons
baseline: Round-two source with endpoint cache enabled, profile off
candidate: Same configuration, omit zero-weight buckets and zero-exponent outer groups in ParallelProver
methodology: Alternating baseline/candidate pairs. Replay preserves captured challenge inputs, positive request arrivals and natural resets; physical engines receive jobs in reconnect order. IPS is iterations / challenge-send-to-complete-wire-receipt time, not mainnet Grafana chain-mapping IPS. Compare identical job/iteration receipts and disclose missing or post-reset deliveries. Microbenchmark uses precomputed reduced forms, times the two-worker constructor, excludes fixture generation and verification. Synthetic workloads queue targets at challenge start. Full segment verification unchanged.

cpu_profile.method: macOS sample, 15 seconds at 1ms, repeated 348K/k4 two-worker construction, reference source
cpu_profile.interpretation: Extended GCD is the largest sampled arithmetic cost. Flat counts are not exact runtime percentages; profiler run is not a completed delivery benchmark.

validation.alternate_fixture: Captured job 1, non-generator initial form; lengths 1,2,8,32,264,1000,3999,4001,7999,8001,16003,100003,250007; k=1,2,4,5,8; all canonical proofs match reference

excluded_runs.reason: One candidate trial reported a bad ASIC value at iteration 2185100 and restarted from 2056000; all 21 complete proofs verified. Failed candidate timing and its paired reference excluded, full pair rerun cleanly. Root cause of the raw-value event not established.
Sleep assertion removed when live guard paused; system slept during first repeat. Pair excluded and replaced under caffeinate. Proofs verified, performance not accepted.
Initial harness smoke had idle EOF at shutdown; ten wire proofs verified but run excluded as a harness failure. Fixed before all accepted comparisons.

limitations: Short controlled tests, not 24-hour stability or mainnet win-rate measurements.
Protocol contains no physical engine identifier; captured logical overlaps preserved, physical reconnect assignment may differ.
Synthetic simultaneous requests impose more CPU contention than this short mainnet trace.
Microbenchmark fixture covers one challenge input; alternate fixture and hardware tests add other inputs but do not exhaust arithmetic inputs.
CPU profile is a sampling result, not a fixed-size GCD implementation benchmark.

One bad raw ASIC value was observed in an initial Homebrew-GMP stress run. Cause not established; all complete proofs verified. Failed pair excluded and rerun cleanly. Native repeats did not reproduce it; this is not a claim of long-term hardware stability.

gmp_audit_correction: Initial hardware cohorts and the round-two synthetic harness used Homebrew GMP because system Python and system shell launchers stripped the override. Relative comparisons remain valid for that library. Microbenchmarks, CPU profile and original live guard used native GMP. Key hardware comparisons repeated with native library paths verified from DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES. Harnesses now accept --gmp-lib-dir, set environment after launcher, and fail before hardware if loader paths do not match.
